decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler was launched recently and its value is still uncertain, while keeping it costs little because it builds on the firm's core air-cooled heat exchanger engineering, so the option stays open.
This air cooled condenser fits the firm's push toward efficient, lower-emission cooling and can be sold to power and process customers at low marginal cost, so it is too early to abandon.
It overlaps with Product B, so it is slightly more likely to be merged or pruned, but one year of data does not show its value is unlikely to be realized, so keeping the option is justified.
The tube liner is a low-cost service product that supports the firm's lifecycle service strategy and repair demand from its installed base, so keeping it costs little and its upside is plausible.
Customized industrial air coolers reflect the firm's core strength in tailored integrated solutions and are built to order, so carrying the offering costs almost nothing.
Tube end repair inserts are inexpensive spare-part offerings that complement maintenance services, so the option is cheap to hold while service demand reveals its value.
